businessContact.emailStatus: no plaintext Music Department business email published on the reviewed official route
businessContact.verification: The official site exposes a first-party Music Department contact form rather than a plaintext mailbox. No address was decoded, inferred from a naming pattern, guessed or copied from a third-party directory. No SMTP, MX, catch-all, mailbox-level or deliverability probing was performed.

formBoundary.manualRecheckReason: The first-party Music Department form requires JavaScript and is suitable only for an asset-free process inquiry because WFMU publishes no digital audio-delivery procedure. A human must inspect the live form and stop if CAPTCHA, consent, authentication, payment, anti-spam or other protected controls appear.

duplicate simultaneous form and physical delivery

activityVerification.evidence: WFMU's official homepage displayed programme archives dated July 15, 2026 and playlists dated July 16, 2026. The site also exposes a Summer 2026 programme schedule and a 2026 Heavily Played recordings section compiled by Music Director Jessica Romoff.

genreFitEvidence: WFMU describes itself as an independent freeform station rather than a format-restricted service.
Its current schedule, playlists and heavily played records support active discovery across unconventional and cross-genre music.
A carefully selected MarcsMusic experimental electronic, world-fusion or reggae-adjacent release may fit, subject to human programme and editorial matching.
newPlatforms.manualReviewReason: WFMU explicitly accepts physical review media and provides a first-party Music Department contact form, but the form requires JavaScript and no digital audio-delivery specifications or AI-origin policy are published. Human review is required for route choice, asset fit, rights, physical-postage approval, final live-form inspection and policy confirmation.

deduplication.repositoryEvidence: The complete open-pull-request patch and repository context were searched for WFMU, wfmu.org, the Send Music path, the Music Department form path and Jessica Romoff. No prior music-submission-agent platform, runtime seed or queue record was found.
deduplication.consolidation: The Music Department contact form and both published physical-delivery addresses are stored as one canonical opportunity. Individual DJs, general staff contacts, record-donation, newsletter and duplicate simultaneous delivery routes are excluded.

notes: One new free-first WFMU opportunity was queued as needs_manual_review. No plaintext Music Department email was stored; the first-party form remains protected and human-reviewed. No form field, email, audio asset, attachment, link, physical package, login, CAPTCHA, consent or payment was submitted.
